responsibility: This implementation module provides the central terminal indirection layer for GNU Modula-2 compatibility I/O. It maintains stacks of active read/status and write procedure bindings, supports push/pop reassignment of handlers, dispatches Read, KeyPressed, and Write through the top-of-stack methods, and initializes the default backend to Keyboard for input and Display for output, halting via M2RTS if no handler is active.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the Termbase pair: it maintains the read/write binding stacks, dispatches calls, installs Keyboard and Display defaults, and halts on missing handlers, all behind the interface in Termbase.def.
